# Actevra Engineering

> Industrial automation and engineering services for machine builders and process automation projects.

Actevra Engineering provides PLC programming, SCADA and industrial data systems, robotics and motion control, functional safety integration, electrical design, commissioning, retrofit and diagnostic engineering.

## Core engineering areas
- TwinCAT 3 PLC programming and structured state-machine architectures
- PackML and ISA-88-oriented machine and batch control
- EtherCAT and CiA-402 drive integration and diagnostics
- .NET / WPF SCADA, ADS, OPC UA, SQL, audit trails and production history
- Robotics and servo motion, including KUKA and ABB integration
- Functional safety using ISO 13849 / IEC 62061 approaches, Pilz, SICK and TwinSAFE
- Industrial cybersecurity considerations aligned with IEC 62443
- Electrical schematics, field I/O and EPLAN engineering
